title: Loopback Streamable HTTP transport
objective: Expose a loopback-only Streamable HTTP MCP transport using the authoritative builder without changing runtime authority: bind only to loopback, require a per-user credential, validate Host and Origin with DNS-rebinding protection, enforce bounded body, header, stream, session, and idle limits, and keep the privileged config surface off the MCP listener.

include: loopback-only Streamable HTTP listener reusing the SG-000048 authoritative builder and result projection
per-user local credential or session secret with fail-closed missing or invalid credentials
Host validation, Origin validation where applicable, and DNS-rebinding protection tests
bounded request body, header count and size, concurrent streams, session lifetime, and idle timeout
correct Streamable HTTP semantics including stateless requests where protocol negotiation permits them
negative tests for LAN exposure, wildcard CORS, oversized frames, expired sessions, and cross-origin browser drives
exclude: any new MCP tool, tool schema change, capability widening, approval change, or authority change
binding to 0.0.0.0, LAN interfaces, or wildcard CORS
any privileged config or admin surface on the MCP listener
relay device transport implementation (reserved for COTRA-P15)
local client packages beyond configuration (reserved for SG-000051)
any P15 remote relay, OAuth, device uplink, or public edge code
any P16 tool-surface widening or provider submission

authority_delta.network: Local loopback listener only; no LAN or outbound authority.

invariants: authoritative builder remains the single tool source of truth
loopback transport adds no independent tool authority
loopback-only bind with no silent LAN exposure
per-user credential required with fail-closed auth
no privileged surface on the MCP listener
no new OS authority beyond the loopback listener

acceptance.claim: A loopback-only Streamable HTTP listener serves the authoritative tool catalog with per-user credential auth and correct session semantics.
Host validation, Origin validation, DNS-rebinding protection, and bound limits are proven by negative tests including browser cross-origin drives.
Transport contract tests prove identical tool surface across stdio and loopback, and all closed SG-000001 through SG-000049 regressions pass unchanged.
Exact-head CI including release qualification and supply-chain audit, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000051: Local client packages may proceed only after SG-000050 closes, documenting loopback plus stdio configuration.

done_when: The loopback Streamable HTTP transport is canonical with auth, validation, bounds, and no authority change.
